sentence_stem: I was very busy this week, so
correct_completion: I could not answer your email.
full_sentence: I was very busy this week, so I could not answer your email.
acceptable_variants: I did not reply to your email.
I did not write back until today.

options.text: I will visit you on Sunday.
options.why_wrong: This is a future plan. It does not show the result of being busy, which is what 'so' needs.

options.text: Thank you for your nice message.
options.why_wrong: This is a polite phrase, but it does not give the result that 'so' introduces.

options.text: I could not answer your email.

options.why_wrong: This is a question. After 'so' we need a statement that completes the cause and effect idea.

explanation: The word 'so' introduces the result of the first clause. Being very busy is the cause, so the result is that the writer could not reply.
translation: Bu hafta çok meşguldum, bu yüzden e-postana cevap veremedim.
